update_log: Baseline initialization of high-frequency national and international sports trophies and cups, categorized by sport for Sports Static GK.

cricket.key_fact: India's premier domestic first-class cricket championship, named after Ranjitsinhji, the first Indian to play international cricket.
Played annually between the incumbent Ranji Trophy winners and the Rest of India team.
A domestic first-class cricket competition named after Kumar Shri Duleepsinhji of Nawanagar.
A historic Test cricket series played strictly between England and Australia.
A Test cricket series played between India and Australia, named after Allan Border and Sunil Gavaskar.

football.key_fact: Founded in 1888, it is the oldest existing football tournament in Asia and the third oldest in the world.
An annual state-level national football championship in India, started in 1941.
A famous inter-school football tournament in India, named after the first Indian Air Force Chief, Subroto Mukerjee.
The oldest still-running international football competition, contested among men's national teams of South America (CONMEBOL).

hockey.key_fact: One of the oldest hockey tournaments in India, highly tested in exams.
Organized by Bengal Hockey Association, it is one of the oldest field hockey tournaments in the world (instituted in 1895).
An annual international men's field hockey tournament held in Malaysia.
The championship trophy awarded annually to the National Hockey League (NHL) playoff winner. (Note: This is for Ice Hockey).

badminton.key_fact: The World Men's Team Championship. (India won its historic first Thomas Cup in 2022).
The world mixed team badminton championship.

tennis.key_fact: The premier international team event in men's tennis, often described as the 'World Cup of Tennis'.
The premier international team event in women's tennis. (Formerly known as the Fed Cup).
An international indoor hardcourt tennis tournament played by mixed-gender teams on a country-by-country basis.

table_tennis.key_fact: Awarded to the winner of the Men's Team event at the World Table Tennis Championships.
Awarded to the winner of the Women's Team event at the World Table Tennis Championships.

golf_and_rowing.key_fact: A biennial men's golf competition between teams from Europe and the United States.
A golf trophy contested in odd-numbered years between leading amateur male golfers of the USA, and Great Britain & Ireland.
A famous Indian national rowing trophy.
